text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Dot: pooled mean (plain mean for sets of fewer than 5 series). Thick purple line: Hartung- Knapp 90% interval, or the range of the series' steps for a set of three. Thin dashed line: 90% interval from resampling whole series. k is the number of series.'
text.tspan: Dot: pooled mean (plain mean for sets of fewer than 5 series). Thick purple line: Hartung-
Knapp 90% interval, or the range of the series' steps for a set of three. Thin dashed line:
90% interval from resampling whole series. k is the number of series.
